@tct.selector.loading.description: Shown in a Selector's or MultiSelector's dropdown panel when the options are still being fetched and none have arrived, and announced in a polite live region once. Short; neutral tone.

@tct.selector.error.description: Shown in a Selector's or MultiSelector's dropdown panel when fetching the options failed and none are available, and announced in a polite live region once. Short; neutral, not blaming.
